create_patterns.name: selection-loaded-nothing-for-simple-put-in-or-on.md
create_patterns.content:
# Loaded nothing for simple put task
Traces t1 'Put a salt shaker in the drawer', t4 'Put a salt shaker on the black table'. Truth: pick_and_place. Nothing loaded. No heat/cool/clean/lamp/count cue, so the plain skill is the default. Absence of cues is itself the signal.

create_patterns.name: selection-loaded-nothing-for-heat-verb-task.md
create_patterns.content:
# Loaded nothing for heat verb
Trace t2 'Heat a tomato and place it on the table'. Truth: pick_heat_then_place. Nothing loaded despite the verb Heat plus place.

create_patterns.name: selection-loaded-nothing-for-cooled-adjective-task.md
create_patterns.content:
# Loaded nothing for cooled adjective
Trace t3 'Place a cooled plate in the cupboard beneath the sink'. Truth: pick_cool_then_place. The word sink is a distractor (not clean). Cooled is the cue.

create_patterns.name: selection-loaded-nothing-for-counted-or-plural-objects.md
create_patterns.content:
# Loaded nothing for two or plural objects
Traces t5 'two spray bottles', t6 'the two laptops', t7 'the alarm clocks' (bare plural, no number), t8 'two sets of keys'. Truth: pick_two_obj_and_place. Nothing loaded. Cues: the word two or a plural noun being moved. Bare plural in t7 is the subtle case.
